name: Escort Probe (research)
description: Research only, for Andoris's bodyguards: can a mod spawn the game's SEAF trooper beside you, keep it with you, and does it fight and take hits? In a mission: Insert a trooper beside you (2 at most, a third replaces the oldest), Home following on/off, Delete takes them away. Shift+Insert (0.6.0): a trooper 25 m under you takes a fresh MG-43 the moment both are ready, drops it, and the MG-43 is moved in front of you. Logs their distance, health and the hits they take. Solo or host. 0.3.0: its Lua half (needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime) logs the game Lua's follow / comm / order functions and their calls. Turn off when done.
